purpose: Provide a small command-line interface for existing quantity-aware totals, with documented defaults and validation. This synthetic fixture qualifies code, product and documentation review plus Oracle evidence; it is not a production rollout.

acceptance.description: The existing total API keeps quantity-aware behavior: total([{price:10,quantity:3}]) returns 30.
node total-cli.js --price 10 returns 10 by default; --price 10 --quantity 3 returns 30; --price 10 --quantity 0 returns 0.
Missing price, repeated or unknown flags, negative values and nonnumeric values produce exit code 2 rather than a total.
README documents the CLI command, the default quantity of one, preservation of explicit zero, and invalid-input behavior.
